plans.text: Plan a long-weekend movie marathon with family, re-watching classic films from the user's childhood.
Include DIY signs reading "Spider-Man's Neighborhood" or "Queens, NY" in the Marvel-themed setup to make it feel more authentic.
Create a cardboard box cityscape that is easy to set up and customizable to fit a Spider-Man theme.
Add The Goonies to the family movie marathon list.
Save The NeverEnding Story for a later time because it might be too intense for some of the younger kids in the family.
Have a movie trivia and quote-along competition.
Play a guess-the-movie-poster game using printed posters of different movies.
Serve popcorn and snacks during the movies.

superseded_plans.text: Create a Marvel-themed photo booth with props such as Spider-Man masks and capes.
Plan a treasure hunt with clues inspired by The Goonies.

preferences.text: Spider-Man: Homecoming would be a great choice for family movie night.
